history.administration_response: The Administration has resolved discount- related matters across contracts between the United Nations and vendors. This included the reconciliation of outstanding amounts, implementation of a credit note mechanism, proactive discount application resulting in cost savings, mutual offsetting of dues and acknowledgement of additional discretionary discounts in certain cases. Some vendor negotiations will proceed to an additional round.
history.board_assessment: Given that negotiations with vendors on discounts due are ongoing, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
